body.statement: Corollary 1 (Oracle-relative replay record).  Every complete RankPeel run emits a transcript \(\mathcal T\) of \(O(p^3+p^2\log p)\) bits for which \(\operatorname{Verify}(P_X,R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X},\mathcal T,\widehat G)=1\).  Replaying it uses at most \(p^2+p\) law-invariant oracle calls and \(O(p^3)\) bookkeeping.  If \((G,P)\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PNHZ}}\) also satisfies the query-local first-jet-determining and fibre-coherence hypotheses, every accepted canonical replay records a graph representing \(\theta_G\); outside that strict subclass, acceptance certifies only faithful replay relative to the supplied oracle.
body.justification: Replay verifies deterministic agreement with the supplied law-invariant oracle; graph-identification soundness additionally uses strict-subclass reconstruction.
body.gap: Outside the repaired subclass, an accepted transcript is not a standalone certificate of the published model assumptions or of \(\theta_G\).
body.consumer: Implementations can reproduce every recorded population decision and distinguish replay consistency from causal soundness.
